description_en: Removes members from an IM group
kebab_example: aliyun cams delete-chat-group-participants --business-number 861380000 --group-id EA93UU0000 --cust-space-id cams-00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteChatGroupParticipants

parameters.help_en: The business number. You can obtain the business number by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 商家号码。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html接口查看商家号码
parameters.name: business_number

parameters.help_en:
The channel type. Valid value:

WHATSAPP

Currently, only the WhatsApp channel is supported
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：

WHATSAPP

暂仅支持WhatsApp通道类型消息
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en: The group ID. You can obtain the group ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer or the instance ID. This ID is also the channel ID. You can find the channel ID on the Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看
parameters.name: cust_space_id

fields.help_en: The participant number of the group member. You can obtain the participant numbers of group members by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932628.html operation
fields.help_zh: 群组成员。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932628.html接口获取群组成员
fields.name: participant_number

parameters.help_en: A list of group members to remove
parameters.name: list
